input: Claim a known issue at work start without replacing an assignee or expanding authority.

assertions.value: Never replace or add to an existing assignment
never edit an issue's title, description or any existing comment
Leave legacy status blocks in issue bodies untouched.
Labels, assignees, milestones and opening or closing issues remain allowed when
post a NEW self-contained comment only at an event
**Started or claimed:** optional and minimal; prefer assignment instead.
**Pull request opened:** link the public PR
**Blocked or paused:** explain the reason, what remains
